items.stem: When you send a normal chat message, what is the AI mainly doing?

options.A: Producing an answer with know-how it already learned
options.B: Rebuilding its entire practice phase from zero
options.C: Hiring a new research team for your question

items.stem: The long phase of learning from many examples is best described as:

options.A: The wait before the AI answers one chat
options.B: The AI's practice phase, when dials get tuned on examples
options.C: The moment you click "copy" on a reply

items.stem: Why is everyday answering usually much faster than the practice phase?

options.A: Chats always use shorter words than books
options.B: Your phone runs hotter than a data center
options.C: Practice updates huge know-how; answering reuses what is already learned

items.stem: A product team says, "We finished the practice phase last year; users only ask it now." What does that mean?

options.A: Users rewrite the internal dials with every click
options.B: Practice already happened; people now use the finished know-how
options.C: The system refuses all new questions after one year

items.stem: Which action is part of using the AI, not the big practice phase?

options.A: Typing instructions and reading the reply in a chat
options.B: Spending weeks adjusting dials on millions of examples
options.C: Building a new computer hall for practice jobs

items.stem: Extra practice on one narrow topic (for example, only medical letters) is:

options.B: The same as one casual chat message
options.C: A focused add-on practice step, still separate from daily Q&A

items.stem: Someone claims each set of instructions you type restarts the whole practice phase. What is wrong?

options.A: Those instructions are illegal in most countries
options.B: Normal use applies existing know-how; full practice is a separate, heavy step
options.C: AI systems cannot read text at all

items.stem: Baking a cake versus serving a slice is a useful picture because:

options.A: Heavy preparation differs from the quick moment of use
options.B: Both steps always take exactly the same time
options.C: Serving changes the recipe inside the oven

items.stem: You notice a wrong answer in chat. What did *not* just happen by default?

options.A: The AI may have followed a weak pattern from older practice
options.B: You may need a clearer question or a human check
options.C: Your single message fully rebuilt the AI's practice phase
